title: Retrospective Evaluations: Utólag visszagondolva, ha újrakezdhetném

sections.title: Reflecting on Life Choices
sections.content: You know *ha* + conditional from A2 Unit 28, the ending -hat/-het from A2 Unit 23 and *utólag* from B1 Unit 39. To look back on your life, use these opening phrases: *utólag visszagondolva* (thinking back in retrospect), *ha újrakezdhetném* (if I could start over), and *mai fejjel már másként csinálnám* (with today's maturity I would do it differently).

items.spanish: Utólag visszagondolva az a kudarc volt életem legfontosabb tanulsága.
items.english: Thinking back in retrospect, that failure was the most important lesson of my life.

items.spanish: Ha újrakezdhetném a pályámat, ugyanezeket a nehézségeket is vállalnám.
items.english: If I could start my career over, I would take on these same difficulties again.

items.spanish: Mai fejjel már sokkal türelmesebb lennék a vitákban.
items.english: With today's mindset, I would be much more patient in arguments.
